title: Following too closely
text: The driver of a motor vehicle shall not follow another vehicle more closely than is reasonable and prudent. A vehicle shall not remain within four metres of the vehicle it is following.

title: Maximum speed
text: No person shall drive a vehicle at a speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour.

title: Speed in a junction
text: A driver shall reduce speed to not more than thirty kilometres per hour while within an intersection.

title: Yielding within an intersection
text: A driver entering an intersection already occupied by another vehicle shall yield, and shall not remain within the intersection until the other vehicle has cleared it.

title: Driving on the right
text: A vehicle shall be driven upon the right half of the roadway, except when overtaking. A vehicle shall not occupy a lane that opposes the flow of traffic while another vehicle is approaching in that lane.

title: Complete stop
text: A driver approaching a stop sign shall bring the vehicle to a complete stop before entering the intersection, and shall remain stopped for not less than one second.

title: Steady red signal
text: A driver facing a steady red signal shall stop before the marked stop line and shall not enter the intersection until the signal turns green, unless already within the intersection when the signal changed.

title: Emergency vehicles
text: Upon the approach of an authorised emergency vehicle, the driver of every other vehicle shall yield the right of way and shall drive to the right-hand edge of the roadway, clear of any intersection.
